entities.summary: Kristers Gudļevskis is a Latvian professional ice hockey player who is a goaltender for the Fischtown Pinguins of the Deutsche Eishockey Liga (DEL). Gudļevskis was selected by the Tampa Bay Lightning in the fifth round, 124th overall, of the 2013 NHL entry draft.
